verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time, export all your channels, and choose Markdown (an open format) or Any-Block as the export format, framed as 'You can leave anytime. Your data goes with you.' Community complaints about the opaque native storage folder concern on-disk storage, not the export feature, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: documentation of what the Markdown export preserves (properties, relations, links, files), any non-Markdown open format for database or relational data, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a full-knowledge-base export works.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can export my entire knowledge base at any time in open formats, so leaving is as easy as arriving

citations.quote: You can import content into your spaces and export it at any time.
Choose your preferred format: Markdown or Any-Block.
export all your channels, and import them into a new identity after switching the network mode
